name: US Squash
summary: The national governing body and membership organisation for squash in the United States, founded in 1904 and based in Philadelphia. It also promotes Squash57 through a national growth campaign.

headquarters.text: Arlen Specter US Squash Center, Drexel University, Philadelphia, United States
headquarters.editorNote: World Squash's member profile (checked 2026-10-25) still lists a New York office address; US Squash's own page names Philadelphia as headquarters.

name: Squash Australia
summary: The national organisation for squash in Australia, founded in 1934. It has a federated structure whose members are the state squash associations.

headquarters.text: Sports House, 150 Caxton Street, Milton, Queensland, Australia

name: Egyptian Squash Federation
summary: Egypt's national squash federation and a full member of World Squash, with its offices at Cairo International Stadium in Nasr City.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: squashegypt.com showed only an Arabic 'under construction' page on 2026-10-25, and the World Squash profile gives no founding date.

headquarters.text: International Cairo Stadium, Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt

name: Scottish Squash
summary: The national governing body for squash and racketball (squash 57) in Scotland, based at Oriam in Edinburgh. It traces its roots to the Scottish Squash Raquets Association, formed in 1936.

founded.text: 1936, as the Scottish Squash Raquets Association (constitution approved 2 October 1936)

headquarters.text: Oriam, Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, United Kingdom

nameChange.text: Formed in 1936 as the Scottish Squash Raquets Association, which later amalgamated with the Scottish Women's Squash Raquets Association; the page does not date the change to the current name

name: Squash Wales
summary: The national governing body for squash in Wales, a member of World Squash and the European Squash Federation, with about 90 affiliated clubs.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: no founding date found on squashwales.com or its World Squash profile; checked 2026-10-25.

headquarters.text: Sport Wales National Centre, Sophia Gardens, Cardiff, United Kingdom

name: Squash Canada
summary: Canada's national squash body, formed in 1915 as the Canadian Squash Racquets Association by five founding clubs. Its office is at York University's Glendon Campus in Toronto.

founded.text: 1915, as the Canadian Squash Racquets Association, with five founding member clubs

headquarters.text: Proctor Field House, Glendon Campus, York University, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

nameChange.text: Formed in 1915 as the Canadian Squash Racquets Association
nameChange.editorNote: The page does not say when the name Squash Canada was adopted.

name: Squash New Zealand
summary: New Zealand's national squash body, a full member of World Squash based in Rosedale, Auckland, which also promotes racketball (squash 57).

founded.editorNote: Not verified: no founding date found on squashnz.co.nz or its World Squash profile; checked 2026-10-25.

headquarters.text: 17 Antares Place, Rosedale, Auckland, New Zealand

name: Squash Rackets Association of Malaysia
summary: Malaysia's national squash association, a full member of World Squash, based at the National Squash Centre in Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: no official site found. The address World Squash lists (malaysia-squash.org) redirected to an unrelated gambling site on 2026-10-25.

headquarters.text: National Squash Centre, Stadium Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

name: Squash Rackets Federation of India
summary: The body that oversees the promotion and development of squash in India, a full member of World Squash with its office in Chennai.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: indiasquash.com says the SRFI 'was formed' but gives no date, and the World Squash profile gives none; checked 2026-10-25.

headquarters.text: Khivraj Complex II, Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai, India

name: Fédération Française de Squash
summary: France's national squash federation, created in December 1980 when squash left the French Tennis Federation, and known by its current name since 1989. It counts about 23,000 licensed players.

founded.text: December 1980, as the Fédération Française de Squash-Raquettes

members.text: About 23,000 licensed players and 300 affiliated clubs

nameChange.text: Created in 1980 as the Fédération Française de Squash-Raquettes; became the Fédération Française de Squash in 1989

name: Deutscher Squash Verband
summary: Germany's national governing body for squash within the German Olympic Sports Confederation, made up of 12 regional associations.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: no founding date found on dsqv.de or its World Squash profile; checked 2026-10-25.

name: Squash Association of Hong Kong, China
summary: Hong Kong's national squash association, a full member of World Squash based at the Hong Kong Squash Centre on Cotton Tree Drive.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: no founding date found on hksquash.org.hk or its World Squash profile; checked 2026-10-25.

headquarters.text: Hong Kong Squash Centre, 23 Cotton Tree Drive, Hong Kong

name: European Squash Federation
summary: The continental federation for squash in Europe, set up in 1973, with 44 affiliated nations and a head office in the Netherlands.

name: Asian Squash Federation
summary: The continental federation for squash in Asia, formed at a meeting of Asian squash nations in Karachi in November 1980. It has 25 affiliated nations and is administered from Hong Kong.

founded.text: 29 November 1980, at a first meeting of Asian squash-playing nations in Karachi
founded.editorNote: Founder members: Bahrain, Bangladesh, Malaysia, Pakistan, Philippines, Singapore and Thailand (same page).

headquarters.text: c/o Squash Association of Hong Kong, China, 23 Cotton Tree Drive, Hong Kong

name: Federación Panamericana de Squash
summary: The regional governing body for squash across North, Central and South America and the Caribbean, established in 1989 with 27 member nations. Its annual championships include a Squash57 event.

name: Oceania Squash Federation
summary: World Squash's continental federation for the Oceania region, formed in 1992, with nine affiliated nations and offices in Milton, Queensland.

headquarters.text: Sports House, 150 Caxton Street, Milton, Queensland, Australia

name: Squash Federation of Africa
summary: The continental squash federation for Africa, with 14 affiliated nations, administered from Gaborone, Botswana.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: squashafrica.org could not be reached on 2026-10-25 and the World Squash profile gives no founding date.

headquarters.text: c/o Botswana Squash Rackets Association, Gaborone, Botswana

name: Professional Squash Association
summary: The organising body of men's and women's professional squash. It runs the PSA Squash Tour and PSA Challenger events, publishes the weekly PSA World Rankings and operates World Squash Officiating.

founded.editorNote: Not verified: no founding date found on psasquashtour.com (About, Privacy and Terms pages) on 2026-10-25.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: psasquashtour.com does not state a head office address on the pages checked on 2026-10-25.
